name: seo-metadata-filler
description: Whenever a product is created or changed, fills in a missing SEO title, meta description, URL slug and image alt text, so no page goes live without them.

howItWorks.label: Trigger
howItWorks.text: A product is created or updated

howItWorks.label: Checks
howItWorks.text: Which SEO fields are empty: title, meta description, slug, image alt text

howItWorks.label: Writes
howItWorks.text: Only the missing ones, from the product's own details

howItWorks.label: Asks you
howItWorks.text: To approve the changes before they are saved

data.description: The product's description, the main source for the meta description
Fields that describe the product: category, material, colour, brand
The page title used by search engines
The meta description used by search engines
The URL slug of the product page
Alt text of the product's images
Whether the product is live on the storefront, so a live slug is never changed

parameters.label: Title suffix
parameters.description: Added to the end of SEO titles when it fits, e.g. " | Northline Goods"; leave empty for none
